note: The three surfaces that draw `ProxyTag`, which must draw the SAME one: the decklist row, the commander caption on the deck head, and the review row. Its own inventory rather than a section of `proxies.json`, because `check:shared` asks the `shares` block of every row in its file — and that file also photographs the list route and the `/decks` tile, neither of which draws a mark. The deck head is a separate row from the decklist even though one `goto` reaches both: the caption is in a `<header>` outside `<main>`, and a shot scrolled to the rows does not show it. `spine-mobile.tsx` gets its OWN row: `check:shared` reads each row's `view` directly, so with the desktop spine alone a phone-only regression would leave the gate green while the mobile caption stopped using the shared mark — the same reason `commander-image.json` carries both spines. And the review row needs `PROXY_REVIEW_DECK`: a versioned deck whose DRAFT holds a printed add, because `admitsReview` redirects a deck with no pending changes and the cell would photograph a redirect. NOT COVERED HERE: `deck-card-tile.tsx` is a fifth renderer of the mark and this file does not check it. Reaching the card view needs a click on a toggle whose choice lives in `localStorage` — no URL addresses it, the runner has no seed verb, and that toggle resolves then times out on click exactly as the Shopping pill does in `proxies.json`. Two labelled toolbar buttons failing the same way is a harness or overlay question rather than a fact about this feature, and it is the follow-up that would let this row exist. Until then the tile's use of the shared mark is held by `deck-card-tile.test.tsx`, which renders a proxied card and asserts the mark rather than a local copy — weaker than an import check, and named as such rather than implied.

shares.note: Each view renders it as-is — no wrapper between them — so the check is asked of the file each row already names.

rows.label: /decks/[id] — the mark on a row, and the key that decodes it
/decks/[id]/changes — a PENDING printed add, marked not billed
/decks/[id] — the mark on a commander caption
/decks/[id] — the commander caption's mark, phone spine
